title: Faizan Farooq Kayani — Interim order review (2026-07-03)
text:
General Pharmaceutical Council
Fitness to Practise Committee
Interim Order Review
On papers
3 July 2026

Registrant name:
Faizan Farooq Kayani
Registration number:

2229280
Part of the register:
Pharmacist

Committee Members:
Neville Sorab (Chair)
Gazala Akram (Registrant member)
Joanna Bower (Lay member)

Secretary:
Marjorie Maghinay

Interim order being reviewed:
Interim conditions of practice order
Outcome:
Interim conditions of practice order continued

1. You must restrict your pharmacy practice to working fora single employer, not
involving any locum or agency work;
2. You must provide the GPhC, in advance of taking on any position for which you
must be registered With the GPhC, with details of your employer and any
supervisor/manager, including contact details;
3. In the course of your pharmacy role, you must have no contact by any means,
including in person, by telephone, email, text message, or any electronic or digital
platform, with patients under the age of 18.

2

4. You must, within two weeks of this order coming into effect, arrange for your
workplace supervisor/manager to provide the GPhC with monthly reports
containing details of the role in which you are employed and confirming your
compliance with these conditions.
5. You must notify any supervisor/manager and any prospective employer in
respect of any position for which you must be registered with the GPhC at the
time of application, of all these conditions and copy that notification to the GPhC.
court: General Pharmaceutical Council — Fitness to Practise Committee
